pip install fails on Ubuntu 24.04 with error: externally-managed-environment
Thought for 4s

ChatGPT said:ChatGPT

The externally-managed-environment error occurs because Ubuntu protects its system Python.

Step-by-step fix

1. Install the venv module

Open your terminal and run:

Bash
sudo apt update
sudo apt install python3-venv -y

2. Create and activate a virtual environment

Bash
python3 -m venv .venv
source .venv/bin/activate

3. Install your packages

Now pip install requests works inside the venv.
